## Blocking finding test

For each proposed blocker, record the direct path, reproduction/trace, violated acceptance or
concrete operational harm, and failing test/reproduction/exploit. Otherwise link it under
Hardening backlog and do not block.

## Bounded review

- Primary review: pending / pass / blockers linked
- Concentrated repair: not needed / commit and blocker IDs
- Verification: not needed / original blockers and direct regressions pass
- Review cycles used: 0 / 1
- Hardening backlog:

## Completion

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and tier-required CI/review pass.
- [ ] No four-condition blocker remains.
- [ ] STATUS/ADR is synchronized when durable state changed.
- [ ] Deferred non-blockers are linked and owned.
- [ ] Product Owner decision: merge / reduce scope / close.
- [ ] Version impact: none / patch / minor / major.
